Cult telegraph and boss rhythm mechanic SFX

Sunken bell toll SFX: deep bronze bell struck with an underwater-muffled low toll and long decay, used as the cult-enemy telegraph and boss rhythm mechanic. Deliver 48 kHz WAV, 3-5 s tail, plus a fast double-toll variant. For a 1930s cursed-island survival game.
